description:
# 👑 M.A.R.A.S — Marriage, Affairs, Relationships, Ancestry & Society
> **SFW Core** • **ESL (0 Slots)** • **`Alt + B` Dashboard** • **Classic RPG or SkyrimNet AI**

Not a dating-sim about bouquets or dinners — **M.A.R.A.S** brings ***Crusader Kings* & *The Sims*** household/dynasty drama to Skyrim. Both **you** & **Skyrim's NPCs** marry, run homes, raise heirs, cheat, & suffer costly divorces.

### ⚔️ Highlights
- **🖥️ `Alt + B` Dashboard:** Manage homes, search all NPCs, track gossip, scale UI (`75–150%`), switch languages, & hide spoilers in **Intrigue Mode**.
- **💍 Marry Anyone (No Forced Ladder):** Propose **Marriage** right away — or stay **Dating** (exclusive) or **Lovers** (no commitment).
- **🏰 Households & Perks:** **14 Buffs**, **2x Monogamy** *or* **Polygamy (`1st–4th+`)**, **9 Home Shops** (`100g/day`), **share spouse homes** (palaces too!), & **Stay at Home** toggles for Jarls/merchants.
- **🧬 Ancestry & 22 Academies:** Unlimited adoptions (you *or* NPC couples!) + dog/critter per kid. With **FMR `1.0.7+` / Beeing Female NG `3.6.4+`**, train kids at **22 Guilds, Shrines & Werewolf Packs** into **Adult Followers** with inherited looks & **Beastblood**!
- **🎭 Affairs, Society & Alimony:** Open relationships, **Partner Agency** (*Talking -> Physical* affairs, walk-ins, notes), paternity scandals, **Alimony**, **NPC matchmaking**, & **town/tavern couple scenes** (both modes!).

### 🎭 Two Ways to Play
- **🎲 Classic (No SkyrimNet):** Full `(M)` menus, **Marriage Chance & Prestige** checks (Affection, Speech, gold, homes, fame, guilds), Persuasion rolls, & dice simulation.
- **🤖 SkyrimNet AI:** `(M)` proposal/affair menus hide for **18 AI actions** — **no stat rolls on proposals** (history & persuasion decide!), **TTS voice**, **"no psychic spouses"** secrecy, & child-to-adult memories.

**⚙️ Req:** SKSE64 • Address Library • Magelight UI • SkyUI • PapyrusUtil • po3 Extender
